***
An **e-transform**. Turns `(s, t)` into `(s ∩ s • e, t ∪ e⁻¹ • t)`. This reduces the
product of the two sets.

```lean

  Finset α × Finset α
```
***
An **e-transform**. Turns `(s, t)` into `(s ∪ s • e, t ∩ e⁻¹ • t)`. This reduces the
product of the two sets.

```lean
Finset.mulETransformRight_inv.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] [CommGroup α] (e : α) (x : Finset α × Finset α) :
  mulETransformRight e⁻¹ x = (mulETransformLeft e x.swap).swap
```
